_comment: Caps equal the measured physical Rust product lines in crates/*/src. Test files and directories (tests/, test_support/, tests.rs, test_support.rs, workspace tests/, and scripts/test-support/) plus inline test-only cfg modules and #[cfg]-gated let/if statements using test-only predicates are uncapped; recognized predicates are #[cfg(test)], #[cfg(all(..., test, ...))], and #[cfg(any(test, feature = "test-hooks"))]. Every other crate src line counts against its per-crate cap and totalMax. Any product-line change updates the affected caps in the same change; headroom is rejected.
